definitions.rationale: This macro equation expands the named encodeLoopBody proof term to the exact translated loop-body statement sequence.
definitions.text:
rule encodeLoopBody
    =>
      Assign(
        Name("char"),
        Call(Attribute(Name("char"), "swapcase"), .Exprs))
      Assign(
        Name("code"),
        Call(Name("ord"), (Name("char"), .Exprs)))
      If(
        BoolOp(
          "or",
          (Compare(Name("code"), CmpOp("==", Int(97))),
           Compare(Name("code"), CmpOp("==", Int(101))),
           Compare(Name("code"), CmpOp("==", Int(105))),
           Compare(Name("code"), CmpOp("==", Int(111))),
           Compare(Name("code"), CmpOp("==", Int(117))),
           Compare(Name("code"), CmpOp("==", Int(65))),
           Compare(Name("code"), CmpOp("==", Int(69))),
           Compare(Name("code"), CmpOp("==", Int(73))),
           Compare(Name("code"), CmpOp("==", Int(79))),
           Compare(Name("code"), CmpOp("==", Int(85))),
           .Exprs)),
        AugAssign(
          Name("result"),
          "+",
          Call(
            Name("chr"),
            (BinOp(
              "+",
              Name("code"),
              Int(2)),
             .Exprs))),
        AugAssign(
          Name("result"),
          "+",
          Name("char")))
      .Stmts

definitions.rationale: This macro equation expands encodeFunctionBody to the initialization, loop, and return statements used as the named function-body proof term.
definitions.text:
rule encodeFunctionBody
    =>
      Assign(Name("result"), Str(""))
      Assign(Name("char"), Str(""))
      Assign(Name("code"), Int(0))
      For(Name("char"), Name("message"), encodeLoopBody)
      Return(Name("result"))
      .Stmts

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the isVowelCode predicate as membership in the ten uppercase and lowercase ASCII vowel code points.
definitions.text:
rule isVowelCode(C:Int)
    => C ==Int 65  orBool C ==Int 69  orBool C ==Int 73
       orBool C ==Int 79  orBool C ==Int 85
       orBool C ==Int 97  orBool C ==Int 101 orBool C ==Int 105
       orBool C ==Int 111 orBool C ==Int 117

definitions.rationale: This is the vowel branch of the case definition for encodeCode, specifying case swap followed by a two-code-point advance.
This is the complementary non-vowel branch of the case definition for encodeCode, specifying only the case swap.
definitions.text:
rule encodeCode(C:Int) => swapC(C)
    requires notBool isVowelCode(swapC(C))

definitions.rationale: This equation is the empty-input base case of the encodeAcc recurrence.
This equation is the nonempty-input recursive case of encodeAcc, appending the encoded head code and recurring on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule encodeAcc(iCons(C:Int, REST:IntSeq), ACC:IntSeq)
    => encodeAcc(
         REST,
         seqConcat(ACC, iCons(encodeCode(C), .IntSeq)))

definitions.rationale: This wrapper equation defines encodeCodes by invoking encodeAcc with an empty output accumulator.
